entry: native tridiag / Householder generation and application
contract: Connects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. SPTRD/HPTRD expand packed storage into an owned dense matrix and convert the real beta gauge of the existing native tridiagonalization to LAPACK AP/TAU form. OPGTR/UPGTR/OPMTR/UPMTR read only the valid tail of the packed reflector and share native Householder application. Zero coefficients in the tail, diagonal, and tridiagonal entries are not referenced when forming or applying Q. SBTRD/HBTRD expand the band and compose the same reduction, returning D/E with Q for VECT=V and X*Q for VECT=U. VECT=N does not reference Q. Complex band E is phase-adjusted to be nonnegative. Verifies fixed WORK, INFO, and storage guards. Internally owned matrices are O(n^2); no claim of the same performance as a dedicated band bulge chase. contract: Connects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. entry: native interval matmul / packed outer products / triangular_solve
contract: Connects 44 Fortran BLAS symbols to both ABIs. Passes only the stored band/packed interval to native multiplication and distinguishes negative strides, complex symmetric versus Hermitian, real diagonals, and the unit diagonal. Triangular solves compose the interval's native dot product and a diagonal solve, and zero columns in the no-transpose case are skipped as in the reference Netlib. No full dense expansion; allocates internal storage for the X snapshot of the product and the necessary row gathers. C ABI is a separate task.

Twelve band/packed/RFP Fortran solve symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Selected triangles are staged into owned dense storage for native triangular solves; right-sided TFSM uses transposed native views. Band width, packed/RFP coordinates, complex transpose/conjugation and unit diagonals are explicit. TBTRS/TPTRS check singular diagonals before solving, including zero RHS columns. TFSM alpha=0 avoids A and old B reads. Internal dense storage is O(n^2); C API is separate.

Twelve band/packed/RFP Fortran solve symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Selected triangles are staged into owned dense storage for native triangular solves; right-sided TFSM uses transposed native views. Band width, packed/RFP coordinates, complex transpose/conjugation and unit diagonals are explicit. TBTRS/TPTRS check singular diagonals before solving, including zero RHS columns. TFSM alpha=0 avoids A and old B reads. Internal dense storage is O(n^2); C API is separate.

Eight packed/RFP Fortran inverse symbols connected for both integer ABIs. Selected triangles are staged into owned dense storage and passed to native triangular inverse. entry: native tridiag / Householder generation and application
contract: Connects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. SPTRD/HPTRD expand packed storage into an owned dense matrix and convert the real beta gauge of the existing native tridiagonalization to LAPACK AP/TAU form. OPGTR/UPGTR/OPMTR/UPMTR read only the valid tail of the packed reflector and share native Householder application. Zero coefficients in the tail, diagonal, and tridiagonal entries are not referenced when forming or applying Q. SBTRD/HBTRD expand the band and compose the same reduction, returning D/E with Q for VECT=V and X*Q for VECT=U. VECT=N does not reference Q. Complex band E is phase-adjusted to be nonnegative. Verifies fixed WORK, INFO, and storage guards. Internally owned matrices are O(n^2); no claim of the same performance as a dedicated band bulge chase. C ABI is a separate task.

Connects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Converts the HGEQZ active range and Q/Z=N/I/V, the dense reduction of GGES/GGES3/GEGS, homogeneous alpha/beta, SELECT and real conjugate pairs, and SDIM. Preserves beta=0. entry: dense expansion / native full-spectrum self-adjoint EVD
contract: Connects 24 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Expands the specified band/packed interval into an owned O(n^2) Hermitian matrix and uses the native full EVD. entry: factorized triangular/split B + native triangular_solve / matmul / reflectors
contract: Connects eight Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. Packed GST reads an external triangular Cholesky factor and applies the congruence transformation for ITYPE=1/2/3. Band GST reads the PBSTF split factor S and, through native block triangular solves and reflector composition, forms C=X^H A X and X^H B X=I within the original bandwidth. Preserves the unspecified triangle, padding, and BB, and reads only the real part of the complex Hermitian diagonal. Allocates dense internal matrices and does not claim the same performance as a dedicated band bulge chase. Band native rejections use the saved ILP64 driver. C ABI is a separate task.

entry: native tridiag / Householder generation and application
contract: Connects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. SPTRD/HPTRD expand packed storage into an owned dense matrix and convert the real beta gauge of the existing native tridiagonalization to LAPACK AP/TAU form. OPGTR/UPGTR/OPMTR/UPMTR read only the valid tail of the packed reflector and share native Householder application. Zero coefficients in the tail, diagonal, and tridiagonal entries are not referenced when forming or applying Q. SBTRD/HBTRD expand the band and compose the same reduction, returning D/E with Q for VECT=V and X*Q for VECT=U. VECT=N does not reference Q. Complex band E is phase-adjusted to be nonnegative. Verifies fixed WORK, INFO, and storage guards. Internally owned matrices are O(n^2); no claim of the same performance as a dedicated band bulge chase. C ABI is a separate task.

entry: native bidiag panels / LAPACK reflector gauge / native GEMV updates
contract: Connects 20 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Normalizes each active column/row, uses the single-column panel of native bidiag_in_place, and converts complex beta and the reciprocal-coefficient convention to LAPACK's real D/E, complex TAUQ/TAUP, and stored vectors. Handles the minimum length and query of caller WORK but allocates internal storage separately. Verifies four types, both ABIs, upper/lower bidiagonal form, rectangular shapes, and interoperability with external factors. C ABI is a separate task.

Passes only the stored band/packed interval to native multiplication and distinguishes negative strides, complex symmetric versus Hermitian, real diagonals, and the unit diagonal. Triangular solves compose the interval's native dot product and a diagonal solve, and zero columns in the no-transpose case are skipped as in the reference Netlib. No full dense expansion; allocates internal storage for the X snapshot of the product and the necessary row gathers. C ABI is a separate task.
Implementable as basic operations. Most current paths use loops in the Rust compatibility layer rather than dedicated colmat-rs kernels

entry: native column magnitude maps, diagonal copies, GEMV and BIN iteration
contract: Connects 38 Fortran symbols to both ABIs. Verifies GEEQU/GBEQU abs1, safe range, and zero-matrix diagnostics; the radix variant coefficients/AMAX; and the PO/PB/PP diagonal readout and SCOND. SYEQUB/HEEQUB implement BIN iteration with native GEMV and normalize the exponent range. This is not a classification asserting independent native APIs of the same name. Allocates internal memory and preserves caller WORK.

entry: native tridiag / Householder generation and application
contract: Connects 16 Fortran symbols, four types, and both ABIs. SPTRD/HPTRD expand packed storage into an owned dense matrix and convert the real beta gauge of the existing native tridiagonalization to LAPACK AP/TAU form. OPGTR/UPGTR/OPMTR/UPMTR read only the valid tail of the packed reflector and share native Householder application. Zero coefficients in the tail, diagonal, and tridiagonal entries are not referenced when forming or applying Q. SBTRD/HBTRD expand the band and compose the same reduction, returning D/E with Q for VECT=V and X*Q for VECT=U. VECT=N does not reference Q. Complex band E is phase-adjusted to be nonnegative. Verifies fixed WORK, INFO, and storage guards. Internally owned matrices are O(n^2); no claim of the same performance as a dedicated band bulge chase. C ABI is a separate task.
